notes: Run of 2026-11-05: 16 queued, read. Phelan default and KPMG deed in lieu earn entries; the rest name no address, mention one in passing, or are market summaries.

findings.description: Lender filed a notice of default on the Phelan Building, 760 Market Street, a 1908 Union Square flatiron.

citation.label: The Registry, “AIG Files Default on $192MM Loan Backing 300,000 SQFT Phelan Building at 760 Market in San Francisco,” 5 November 2026

raw.text: AIG Files Default on $192MM Loan Backing 300,000 SQFT Phelan Building at 760 Market in San Francisco

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 760 MARKET ST → parcel 0328001; sf-parcels has blklot 0328001 active, 750–780 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1908. EAS puts 750, 760, 764, 768, 776, 780 MARKET ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 750.

findings.description: Ellis Partners took ownership of the former KPMG Building, 55 Second Street, via deed in lieu after buying its defaulted loan.

raw.text: Ellis Partners Takes 386,000 SQFT KPMG Building in San Francisco via Deed in Lieu After Buying $187.5MM Loan

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 55 02ND ST → parcel 3708096; sf-parcels has blklot 3708096 active, 55–55 02ND; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 2002. EAS files the address under parcel 3708033, which sf-parcels reports retired; the active parcel its coordinates fall in is 3708096. The record spells the street out as SECOND; EAS holds the numbered streets as zero-padded ordinals, so this is 02ND.
